text: Just had a quite emotional, personal conversation w/ ChatGPT in voice mode, talking about stress, work-life balance. Interestingly I felt heard & warm. Never tried therapy before but this is probably it? Try it especially if you usually just use it as a productivity tool.

author: lilianweng
text: 🦖Large Transformers are powerful but expensive to train & use. The extremely high inference cost is a big bottleneck for adopting them for solving real-world tasks at scale. Check out my new post on some ideas on inference optimization for Transformers: https://t.co/PIr4GHRsA3
